This template creates a custom interwiki field, replacing the default interwiki format of MediaWiki. It has been adapted by Wookieepedia to be independent of Fandom in its choice of interwiki partners following a discussion in the [[Forum:CT:Foreign language link issues|Consensus track]]. If you find a page in the old format, feel free to update it, and please use the new format from now on in new pages.

The template should be placed between the article text with all its templates and the categories. Parameters should be in alphabetical order. Alternatively you can use [[Wookieepedia:HotCat|HotCat]] tool.

==Usage==
'''Old format:'''
<pre><nowiki>{{FA|de}}{{FA|es}}
[[da:Anakin]]
[[de:Anakin]]
[[es:Anakin]]
[[fi:Anakin (täsmennyssivu)]]</nowiki></pre>

'''New format:'''
<pre><nowiki>{{Interlang
|da=Anakin
|de=Anakin
|es=Anakin
|fi=Anakin (täsmennyssivu)
|deFA=1
|esGA=1
}}</nowiki></pre>

'''Output:'''
{{Interlang
|da=Anakin
|de=Anakin
|es=Anakin
|fi=Anakin (täsmennyssivu)
|deFA=1
|esGA=1
}}

[[Category:Interwiki link templates]]
</noinclude>
